description: This file defines the Connection class within the OrangeHRM installer utilities, responsible for establishing and managing database connections using Doctrine DBAL, and includes connection setup and singleton management.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the database connection within the installer context, encapsulating connection creation with specific parameters and providing accessors for the connection instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Private constructor that initializes the database connection using parameters fetched from StateContainer and sets up type mappings.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Static method that returns the singleton database connection instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Static method to reset the singleton connection instance, allowing for reinitialization.
